summary:
ASTROCARE – AI-Powered Astronaut Healthcare Monitoring System

ASTROCARE is an intelligent healthcare monitoring platform designed to improve astronaut health and safety during space missions. Space exploration exposes astronauts to challenges such as radiation, sleep disturbances, bone density loss, and changes in physical health. ASTROCARE aims to address these challenges through an integrated digital platform.

The website provides an interactive dashboard featuring astronaut health monitoring, vital signs tracking, sleep analysis, bone health monitoring, radiation exposure tracking, spacesuit monitoring, and crew profiles. It also includes an AI-powered medical assistant to provide health-related guidance and support.

By combining artificial intelligence, data visualization, and health monitoring tools, ASTROCARE helps identify potential health risks and supports better decision-making during missions. Its main goal is to contribute to safer, healthier, and more sustainable human space exploration, especially during long-duration missions to the Moon and Mars.
details: AstroCare is an AI-powered astronaut health assistant. It monitors vitals like heart rate, SpO₂, temperature and ECG against personal baselines, flags disease and radiation risks, and provides NASA-based medical protocols. It also tracks the ISS and satellites in 3D using NASA orbital data, supporting astronaut decisions during long space missions.
